name: dev3
seeds: Hi, I'm Tobias Brenner, born 9.7.1983. I run my own joinery, Brenner Möbelbau, which I founded on 1.4.2016. Until April 2020 we lived in Emmendingen, then we moved to the Wiehre district in Freiburg.
My wife Katrin and I got married on 14.6.2019. She brought her daughter Mia (born 2012) into the family, so Mia is my stepdaughter. Our son Paul was born on 22.8.2021.
From my first marriage to Sabine (married 2008, divorced 2015) I have a son, Jonas, born 3.2.2010. He lives with his mum in Emmendingen, and I pay Sabine 480 € a month child support for him.

seeds.text: 11.11.2023. Papa died early this morning. Dieter Brenner. Mama (Ursula) sat with him through the night. My half-brother Florian came down on the night train from Hamburg, where he lives. I still can't quite believe it.

seeds: The estate was settled in March 2024: I inherited Papa's piece of forest near Elzach (Flurstück 418/2) plus 40.000 € from his savings. Mama kept the house in Emmendingen.

My mother-in-law Gisela lives in Kenzingen and picks Paul up from kindergarten every Tuesday. Katrin's brother Marco lives in Basel. In June 2025 I put 2.000 € into Florian's crowdfunding for his café in Hamburg-Altona, and it opened on 1.3.2026.
My best friend Stefan Maier was best man at our wedding, and his son Leon is my godson. Downstairs live our neighbours, Helmut and Ingrid Wiegand.

Before going self-employed I worked as a journeyman at Schreinerei Kühn in Waldkirch, from 2009 until March 2016. In 2014–2015 I did my master craftsman course at the Meisterschule Freiburg; that's where I met Jan Albers.
Jan joined Brenner Möbelbau as my business partner on 1.1.2020. He holds 30 % of the company and I hold 70 %; I'm the managing director.
We have two employees: Ayşe Demir, a carpenter, has been with us since September 2018, and our apprentice Niklas Vogt started on 1.8.2024. Ayşe supervises Niklas in the workshop.

Our workshop is a hall in Gundelfingen that I rent from Gewerbehof Gundelfingen GmbH, since April 2016, for 1.450 € a month. To equip it I took out a 30.000 € loan from the Breisgauer Volksbank in May 2021 for a new edge-banding machine.

seeds.text:
Subject: Annual accounts 2025

Dear Mr Brenner,

attached is my invoice for the 2025 annual accounts of Brenner Möbelbau, 2.380 € incl. VAT. I would also like to see you for our tax planning meeting on 22.10.2026 at 10:00 in my office.

Kind regards
Monika Esser
Tax adviser

seeds: Paid Monika's invoice for the 2025 accounts (2.380 €) on 12.5.2026. I've been a member of the Schreiner-Innung Freiburg since 2016 and on its board since 2025; this year's membership fee of 420 € went out on 15.2.2026. Next deadline: the Q3 VAT return is due on 10.11.2026.
Our biggest client is Hotel Schwarzwaldblick in Titisee. In June we delivered 32 bedside tables and wardrobes for their new wing; my invoice was 48.600 € and they paid it on 28.7.2026.

seeds.text:
Brenner Möbelbau – Schreinerei, Gundelfingen
RECHNUNG Nr. BM-2026-041
Rechnungsdatum: 2.9.2026
An: Praxis Dr. Roth, Freiburg
Leistung: Empfangstheke Eiche massiv, inkl. Lieferung und Montage
Gesamtbetrag: 12.300,00 € (inkl. 19 % USt.)
Zahlbar bis 2.10.2026 ohne Abzug.

seeds: Katrin and I bought our flat in the Wiehre on 15.3.2020 from Werner Lorenz for 385.000 €, half each. In the land register it's Grundbuch von Freiburg, Blatt 20417.

On 10.10.2025 I bought a new Ford Transit for the business from Autohaus Schmieder for 31.900 €, plate FR-BM 412. It's insured with the Badische Gewerbeversicherung, policy BGV-7781-23, which renews on 1.1.2027. A month earlier, on 2.9.2025, I sold the old VW T5 I'd had since 2014 to Malte Krüger for 9.800 €; its plate was FR-TB 77.

We're renovating the bathroom and kitchen of the Wiehre flat, let's just call it the renovation. Budget: 42.000 €. It should be finished by 31.7.2026. Ayşe and I are building the kitchen units ourselves in the workshop.

seeds.text:
Subject: Quote – bathroom plumbing

Hello Mr Brenner,

as discussed, here is my quote for the plumbing in your bathroom renovation: 18.400 € gross, including the walk-in shower and all new pipes. 50 % deposit when work starts, the rest on completion.

Best regards
Ralf Gerber
Plumbing & Heating

seeds: Accepted Gerber's quote on 20.3.2026. For the tiling we're going with Dimitri Popescu; his quote is 9.200 €, accepted the same day.
The renovation started on 13.4.2026. Paid Ralf Gerber the 9.200 € deposit on 14.4.2026, and demolition was finished on 24.4.2026. My mother-in-law Gisela contributed 15.000 € towards it in April.

seeds.text: 12.6.2026. Plumbing rough-in done today. But the tiles from Italy are stuck at the supplier and Dimitri can't start before August, so the renovation won't be finished before 30.9.2026. Katrin is losing patience with the camping kitchen.

seeds: Paid the last instalment on the Volksbank loan on 15.12.2025, so the company is debt-free. I pay myself a managing director's salary of 5.200 € a month from Brenner Möbelbau; Katrin works as a nurse at the Uniklinik Freiburg and earns about 3.400 € net a month.
Two corrections: Ayşe actually started in September 2017, not 2018. And the Transit ended up costing 32.400 €, not 31.900 €, because the towbar came on top.
Smaller project: Lara Fink, a freelance web designer, is relaunching the Brenner Möbelbau website. We kicked it off on 7.9.2026; her quote is 3.200 € and go-live is planned for 1.12.2026.
We spent 1.8. to 14.8.2025 in Lisbon. In the autumn holidays, 27.–31.10.2026, Katrin, Mia, Paul and I are going to Lake Constance. Next summer we plan to go to Norway.
Kurze Notiz: Mein Reisepass läuft am 14.5.2027 ab, und der TÜV für den Transit ist im September 2027 fällig. Am 3.11.2026 habe ich einen Zahnarzttermin.

Asset update: on 14.5.2025 I sold 40 m³ of spruce from the Elzach forest to Sägewerk Faller for 3.600 €. I've decided to keep the forest itself for Paul and Jonas. And the bank appraised our Wiehre flat on 8.10.2026 at 470.000 €.
Jan and I decided on 23.9.2026 not to bid for the Basel school tender: too far away and too big for the two of us.
Paid Lara the first 1.600 € for the website on 5.10.2026, and we approved her design on 9.10.2026. How much have I paid out for the renovation so far?

Dimitri started tiling on 1.9.2026 and I paid him 4.600 € on 2.10.2026. The shower glass is delayed as well, so the new finish date for the renovation is 20.11.2026. What's still outstanding on the renovation?

Plans for 2027: I want to hire a second carpenter, and in spring I plan to buy a CNC machine for around 60.000 €. Long term my dream is our own showroom in Freiburg's old town. Katrin wants to go down to 75 % part-time from January 2027, and Jonas wants to do his carpentry apprenticeship with us after he finishes school next summer. Mama was born on 21.3.1957; for her 70th we're planning a big family party in Kenzingen.
The workshop lease runs until 31.3.2027, and I intend to extend it by five years. I've also booked a stand at the Möbelmesse Süd in Stuttgart on 24.3.2027.
